fields.label: Margin at today's price (%)
fields.formula: IF({Selling at now (USD)} > 0, ROUND(({Selling at now (USD)} - {Cost per unit (USD)}) / {Selling at now (USD)} * 100, 0), 0)

fields.label: Sell-through (%)
fields.formula: IF({Units sold} + {Units on hand} > 0, ROUND({Units sold} / ({Units sold} + {Units on hand}) * 100, 0), 0)

text.text: Start from last year's sales for the season, in cost. Add what you expect to grow, take off what was left at the end of the season, and that is what you can spend. Hold back about 15 percent for reorders of what sells. A boutique that spends the whole budget at market has no money for the style that sells out in week two.

every Monday. A delivery that is late for a season is worth less every week it is late: winter coats in January sell at markdown. If it has not shipped, call the rep. Cancel or ask for a discount in writing, and note the answer.
At the end of each season, sort

by sell-through. Styles over 70 percent at full price: buy deeper next year. Styles under 40 percent: buy fewer sizes, or none. Look at sizes too: if the M sells out and the L sits, change the size split on the next buy.
A markdown is not a failure. It turns slow stock into money for the styles that sell. Do it on a schedule, not on a feeling.

Final sale means no returns or exchanges. Say it at the till and print it on the receipt. When a customer asks to return a final-sale piece, log the request, explain kindly, and set it to
. A piece with a real flaw is the exception: take it back.
What is left at final sale after two weeks goes to a sample sale, an outlet event, or back to the vendor if your terms allow. Do not carry it into the next season: it takes rail space from new stock.
Local designers make the shop feel like nowhere else. Consignment lets you carry them without buying stock up front. Clear terms keep the relationship good.
The designer brings pieces; you do not pay for them until they sell.
When a piece sells, the designer gets their share of the sale price (60 percent here) and the shop keeps the rest. The share is on the vendor row.
Pieces stay 90 days. Unsold pieces are returned or swapped for new work.
The designer sets the price with you. No markdowns without their written yes.
